lines.zh: 我一步一顿，地面都在颤。
lines.en: Every step lands like a drumbeat and the ground shivers.

lines.zh: 五百点血，走起路来很稳。
lines.en: Five hundred points of health; I walk very steadily.

lines.zh: 我浑身披挂，像会走路的铠甲。
lines.en: I'm all plated over, armor that walks.
I step forward. Nobody stands in the way.

lines.zh: 我这身重量，一步顶别人三步。
lines.en: With this weight, one of my steps covers three of yours.

lines.zh: 我从田埂上过去，草都倒了。
lines.en: I cross the field ridge and the grass goes flat.

lines.zh: 我慢慢逼近，这就是我的风格。
lines.en: I close in slowly. That's my style.

lines.zh: 我的脚尖很大，踩出坑来。
lines.en: My toes are huge and leave pits.

lines.zh: 我转身的时候，得转一大圈。
lines.en: Turning takes a whole arc.
I walk toward you. No need to run.
Push me and I won't shift.

lines.zh: 我最后停在离你两步的地方。
lines.en: I stop two paces from you.

lines.zh: 走完之后，我身上还在晃。
lines.en: When I stop, the weight still settles.
A frame this big goes through doors sideways.
I stand like a small hill.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬手，关节咔咔响。
lines.en: I lift an arm and the joints crack.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看你，脖子弯得慢。
lines.en: I look down at you; my neck bends slowly.
I wait. I can afford to.
My armor is covered in dents.

lines.zh: 我慢慢吐了口气，像风箱。
lines.en: I let out a breath like a bellows.

lines.zh: 我不动，别的东西都不敢动。
lines.en: I hold still and nothing else dares move.

lines.zh: 我把两只手对撞了一下。
lines.en: I clap my two hands together.

lines.zh: 我在数自己的呼吸，很慢。
lines.en: I count my breaths. Slow ones.

lines.zh: 这身护甲是被敲出来的。
lines.en: This armor was hammered onto me.

lines.zh: 我把面甲摆正，关节咔一声。
lines.en: I set my visor straight; a joint cracks.
I work out how long I can stand.

lines.zh: 我动了动脚趾，里面很闷。
lines.en: I flex my toes. Cramped in there.

lines.zh: 这地方安静得不像样子。
lines.en: Untroubled quiet, this place.
You stand straight. Too thin, though.
I look down and my shadow covers you.
Not afraid of me? Interesting.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，打不穿我。
lines.en: What you're holding won't pierce me.
I lift a foot and you're back before it lands.

lines.zh: 我笑了，声音闷在头盔里。
lines.en: I laugh; it's muffled in the helmet.
If we fight, come at me head on.
I don't dodge. No need.
Ten points of armor. Knock away.
Take your time thinking. I won't rush you.

lines.zh: 你已经站在我的范围里了。
lines.en: You're already inside my reach.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看一只小鸡。
lines.en: I look at you like a chick.

lines.zh: 我隔着护甲也看得见你抖。
lines.en: I see you shaking even through my visor.

lines.zh: 我低下身，才和你差不多高。
lines.en: I stoop and we're nearly level.
That left a mark and nothing more.
One spin, and I am back on my feet.
It hurts, but I can bear it.
Another mark on the armor.

lines.zh: 护甲凹了一处，我才退一步。
lines.en: One dent in the plating, and one step back.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的护甲响了一声。
lines.en: That set my plating ringing.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩手，把麻劲散掉。
lines.en: I shake my hand to clear the numbness.
Something creaks in the bone. No matter.
I'll have to take it slowly.

lines.zh: 好，我认真了，护甲十点不是摆设。
lines.en: All right, I am serious; ten armor points are not decoration.
You've raised something. Put it down.

lines.zh: 那东西对我的护甲没用。
lines.en: That's no use against my plating.
I don't lack things. I lack opponents.
Trading that for your life — worth it?
Hand it over. Let me see.
I reach out and the ground shakes.
I can pinch that much fine.
You pulled it back. Wise.
No hurry. Think it over.

lines.zh: 五百点血，转个圈都费劲。
lines.en: Five hundred health, and even a spin is work.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的样子，像撞墙。
lines.en: You ran into me like a wall.
You're still reeling; my foot hasn't moved.

lines.zh: 你被弹开了，我听见骨响。
lines.en: You bounced off. I heard something crack.
This plating is rough to run into.
Don't push. I'm heavier than you think.

lines.zh: 我抬脚换了个位置，地凹了。
lines.en: I move a foot and the ground dips.

lines.zh: 你站直了，也只到我胸口。
lines.en: Standing tall, you still reach only my chest.
Go on, push. It won't help.
I stand still until you're done bumping.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，还晃了晃。
lines.en: You stepped back and still wobbled.
With this frame I can't hold anyone.
Beat me first, then we'll talk.

lines.zh: 我一天到晚待着，也习惯了。
lines.en: I'm on my own all day. Used to it.
Don't come too close; the plate chafes.

lines.zh: 我这么大，两个人也挤得下。
lines.en: I'm big enough that two could fit.

lines.zh: 你说话我不太听得清，头盔闷。
lines.en: I can't hear you well. The helmet muffles it.
Someone at my side wouldn't be bad.

lines.zh: 我不懂温柔，我只会站着挡。
lines.en: I don't know gentleness. I only know how to block.
If you stay, stand behind me.

lines.zh: 我这人很闷，你受得了吗？
lines.en: I'm dull company. Can you stand it?
I bend and my armor clanks through a whole scale.

lines.zh: 五百点血，这东西太小了。
lines.en: Five hundred points. This thing is too small.
I pinch it up, afraid I'll crush it.
I set it in my palm and look.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我替你收着。
lines.en: What fell, I'll keep for you.

lines.zh: 我一弯腰，影子就压过来。
lines.en: When I bend, my shadow comes down over everything.

lines.zh: 这么轻的东西，我留着看。
lines.en: Something this light, I'll keep to look at.
I hold it up and turn it.
I put it back. Don't drop it again.

lines.zh: 两根手指夹起，盔甲都没响。
lines.en: Two fingers lift it; my armor does not even creak.
You moved, so I move.

lines.zh: 我把整座山的重量压到前脚。
lines.en: I shift a hill's weight onto my front foot.

lines.zh: 你已经在我抬手能碰到的距离。
lines.en: You're within arm's reach now.
I've marked you. Don't try to circle.

lines.zh: 你跑起来也没我一步长。
lines.en: Run all you like; your strides won't match mine.
I raise my hand. Slowly.

lines.zh: 你的武器在我眼里像根棍。
lines.en: Your weapon looks like a stick to me.
I press forward and you can't back off.
I've got you inside two paces.

lines.zh: 好，我的舞步要落下来了。
lines.en: Right. My steps are about to come down.
My dance steps on your shadow.
I don't like chatter. Come on.
Five hundred health, and I am plated all over.
You've backed to the wall. No way left.
I raise both hands. Slow but sure.

lines.zh: 你的攻击到我身上就停了。
lines.en: Your blows stop at my plating.
I don't chase. I only walk.
I measure the gap. Two paces.

lines.zh: 你打一下就退，这可不行。
lines.en: Hit and retreat won't do.

lines.zh: 门框太窄，我站在那儿就够了。
lines.en: The doorway's narrow; standing here is enough.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬手，你还有时间跑。
lines.en: I raise my hand slowly. You still have time.
I can hear you panting.
The ground complains under me.
One more step and I'm on you.
My fist comes down and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 这一下带着全身的重量。
lines.en: That one carried all my weight.

lines.zh: 我横扫一臂，你飞了出去。
lines.en: One sweep of my arm sends you flying.
Your shield dented and your grip weakened.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩，你就动不了。
lines.en: I grip your shoulder and you're stuck.
My helmet meets your forehead.
I stamp a foot and your footing fails.
I didn't use my full strength there.
Your hits land like rain on me.

lines.zh: 我推你一把，你滑出去老远。
lines.en: One shove and you slide a long way.

lines.zh: 我落地，扬起的土有几尺高。
lines.en: I land and raise dust several feet.

lines.zh: 五百点的血，够我耗一整天。
lines.en: Five hundred points. Enough for a whole day.

lines.zh: 这身护甲是别人敲给我的。
lines.en: This armor was hammered onto me by others.

lines.zh: 我站着，别的都显得小了。
lines.en: I stand, and everything else looks small.
I step over a low wall.
I fasten my bracer with a click.
Open ground. Suits me.

lines.zh: 我吐了口气，风都变了向。
lines.en: I exhale and the wind changes direction.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过身，看看四周。
lines.en: I turn slowly and look around.

lines.zh: 五百点生命，够我跳完这支舞。
lines.en: Five hundred points; enough for this dance.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声，半个村子都听得见。
lines.en: Half the village can hear my steps.
Come on. I'm waiting.

lines.zh: 火在护甲上滑开，烫不进。
lines.en: Fire slides off the plate and can't get in.
I fall and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 这身甲太重，我往水底沉。
lines.en: This armor's too heavy; I sink.
The blast moves me half a step.
An arrow sticks in a seam.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的膝盖一软。
lines.en: That force weakens my knees.

lines.zh: 饿久了，连拳头都抬不动。
lines.en: Hungry enough that I can't lift a fist.

lines.zh: 雷打在我护甲上，电流到处跑。
lines.en: Lightning hits my plate and the current runs everywhere.
Nothing in the void to stand on.
